rv.q: I HIGHLY RECOMMEND! You do – you’ll be as awestruck as I was for the grim experiences and searing disclosures Andrea is led to by her great-grandfather’s diaries.
The power of The Berlin Diaries is that it makes us wish that the story were true, and it helps us feel a growing sense of loss right alongside Stolowitz as she digs into the past.
What that effort cannot do though is just as interesting and enlightening.
The play is hopelessly confusing, with too much distance between the characters and the audience.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this personal WWII-era family history, praising strong performances and ambitious storytelling but finding the narrative confusing and emotionally distant for some viewers.
